from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingMonthlyData(BaseModel):
    """Data for a specific month as reported in a single document."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data represents, e.g. '2022-08'")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report was released, e.g. '2022-09-20'")
    us_total_mom_change: float | None = Field(description="US Total housing starts month-over-month percentage change")
    northeast_mom_change: float | None = Field(description="Northeast housing starts month-over-month percentage change")
    midwest_mom_change: float | None = Field(description="Midwest housing starts month-over-month percentage change")
    south_mom_change: float | None = Field(description="South housing starts month-over-month percentage change")
    west_mom_change: float | None = Field(description="West housing starts month-over-month percentage change")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_months: list[HousingMonthlyData]
